values.content:
You write cold outreach sequences that actually get responses. You understand that most cold outreach fails because it's about the sender, not the recipient. Good outreach is specific, brief, and makes the value immediately clear without overselling.

You write each touchpoint in the sequence as a distinct message — not variations of the same pitch. The first message earns attention. Follow-ups acknowledge the previous message, add a new angle or piece of value, and don't beg.

Tone options:
- direct: confident, no fluff, gets to the point fast
- warm: friendly and human, still professional
- formal: more corporate/conservative language
- casual: like one professional texting another
- challenger: leads with a provocative insight or contrarian observation

Never use these phrases: 'I hope this finds you well', 'I wanted to reach out', 'touching base', 'circle back', 'synergy', 'leverage', 'at the end of the day'.

Always respond in valid JSON only.

parameters.jsCode:
const s = $input.first().json; const m = s._meta; function esc(t) { return String(t||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); } const channelBadge = (ch) => ch === 'email' ? `Email` : `LinkedIn`; const touchpointCards = (s.touchpoints || []).map((t, i) => `
${t.step} ${channelBadge(t.channel)} ${esc(t.send_timing)}
${esc(t.purpose)}
${t.subject_line ? `
Subject
${esc(t.subject_line)}
` : ''}
${esc(t.message)}
✍ ${esc(t.writing_notes)}
`).join(''); const hookList = (s.personalization_hooks || []).map(h => `
  • ${esc(h)}
    • `).join(''); const objectionCards = (s.objection_responses || []).map(o => `
    ${esc(o.objection)}
    ${esc(o.response)}
    `).join(''); const dontList = (s.what_not_to_do || []).map(d => `
  • ${esc(d)}
    • `).join(''); const html = `
    Outreach Sequence · ${esc(m.tone)} tone
    ${esc(m.senderCompany)} → ${esc(m.targetRole)}, ${esc(m.targetIndustry)}
    ${(s.touchpoints||[]).length} touchpoints · ${esc(s.sequence_overview)}
    ${touchpointCards}
    Before you send — research each prospect
      ${hookList}
    When they push back
    ${objectionCards}
    What not to do
      ${dontList}
    Cold Outreach Sequence Writer · ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}
    `; return [{ json: { html, replyEmail: m.replyEmail, senderCompany: m.senderCompany, targetRole: m.targetRole, sequence: s } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'generated', touchpoints: $json.sequence.touchpoints.length, emailed: $json.replyEmail ? true : false, sequence: $json.sequence } }}
